39:22.text: So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to
? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.

39:23.text: Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance
of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

39:24.text: Then is he who will shield with his face
the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection
? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."

39:25.text: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

39:26.text: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

39:27.text: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every

39:28.text: an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance

39:29.text: Allāh presents an example: a man
owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.

39:30.text: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

39:31.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
